About Us
Saga Telecom is a reliable manufacturer and trader of good-quality fiber optic devices and transmission solutions, and focuses on industrial networking, CCTV surveillance, fiber optic transmission and featured telecom devices for secure data transport, fiber-based communication, and security monitoring
Backed by diversified product portfolio and mature business system, Saga Telecom gains good feedback overseas particularly in European countries
In the meantime, Saga Telecom is actively seeking trustworthy partners and enhancing its presence in the network telecommunications field
Core Value
Connecting, Converting, Creating
Saga Telecom connects talents and ideas that may drive itself forward
Saga Telecom converts mature business system to all-round growth
Saga Telecom creates betterness from expertise and solution package
Factory Information
Our production base is in Huizhou city, Guangdong Province
Production Area: 7,000 square meters
Production Capacity(Per Month): Around 3K for popular DIN-Rail models
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1B-DHQaO29xaEhEGfVhdTen9Leo35sRoc?usp=drive_link
Market Positioning
OEM Factory
Tailored Managed Networking Solutions Provider
Saga Telecom focuses on customizing services regarding hardware & software based on Marvell/CENTEC chips
Access Layer: Marvell AellyCat5 Series(AC5)
https://www.marvell.com/content/dam/marvell/en/public-collateral/switching/marvell-prestera-98DX25xx-product-brief.pdf
https://www.marvell.com/content/dam/marvell/en/public-collateral/switching/marvell-prestera-98DX35xx-product-brief.pdf
Aggregation & Core Layer: CENTEC
https://www.centec.com/silicon?category=Ethernet-Switch-Silicon
Continuous Supply
We guarantee continuous supply for more than 5 years
All upcoming R&D, hardware optimization, and software development will remain fully aligned along the way
This is supported by:
Our business strategy: a built-to-last approach ensuring continuous supply and collaborative evolution
Long-term availability of Marvell AC5 and CENTEC switching chipsets
This ensures uninterrupted delivery and consistent performance for our clients of all types(SIs, ISPs, Telcos, OEMs and more)
Personnel Strength
HW Engineer: 5
SW Engineer: 10
Test Engineer: 5
Number of SMT Line: 2
Number of DIP Line: 5
Number of Test Line: 4
Number of Assembly Line: 10
Production Step
The standard production mainly consists of 8 steps
Processing>Cleaning>Assembling>Testing>Aging>Performance Testing>QC Testing>Packing
PCBA Processing: SMT welding and DIP insertion.
With professional equipment, this increase accuracy and efficiency.
Cleaning: To avoid any possible dysfunction due to dust or scraps on the PCB boards.
Conformal coatings will sometimes be used to protected the PCB boards.
Assembling: Build up components of a product, like panels, screws, PCB boards.
Basic Testing: To make sure the product, after assembling, is basically working fine such as LED indicator, voltage range...
Aging: This is a preparation step for comprehensive performance test.
Devices will be put in the ageing chamber for 8 or 24 hours.
Performance Testing: This requires professional equipment to check if the device meets the standard such as lighting surge, data loss or working temperature range...
THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP TO SECURE GOOD QUALITY.
QC Testing: This is the third and also last check covering product appearance and ping testing.
Device outlook will be inspected to avoid improperly placed PVC mask or scratches on the casing.
Ping testing will be done to all the devices and then there will be another random testing.
Packing: Labels will be attached on the device, accessories(user manual, mounting kit, power supply ...)will be placed in the box for sealing.
When all above is done, the product will go to market.
Remark
Ageing Time: 8 to 24 hours(at least 8 hours)
8 hours for frequently ordered models
24 hours for customized models to ensure stable operation
The actual ageing time depends on complaint rate and order urgency
If we have not received negative feedback for a long time(like popular models STI-244GP and STI-050GE), we simply do the ageing time 8 hours for fast delivery
